title: Gilbert Ghost Hunt: Self-Guided Haunted Walking Quest
includes: Mobile access code to unlock the quest
Built-in GPS map for real-world navigation
Pause/resume flexibility — explore at your own pace
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the supernatural as you explore the ghostly legends of downtown Gilbert! On this spine-tingling self-guided quest, you'll play as a fearless ghost hunter tracking a mysterious apparition through the Heritage District’s historic streets.

Guided by the app, you’ll follow a trail of eerie clues and creative puzzles, uncovering secrets behind local landmarks, public art, and haunted hotspots. Along the way, you’ll explore the city’s most iconic areas — from colorful murals and sculptures to charming alleys and hidden corners — all while unraveling a spooky story rooted in local lore.

What makes this tour unique? It’s a one-of-a-kind mix of ghost story, walking tour, and outdoor escape game — blending sightseeing, storytelling, and puzzle-solving into a fun adventure you can do anytime.

Perfect for friends, families, couples, and solo adventurers looking to explore Gilbert in a new, interactive way. Dare to walk the haunted path!
